kind_of_no: owner-lot condo with no resort booking site (owners rent through agents)
why: Read 2026-10-30: the association's own site ventureoutcondo.com says 'Venture Out Condo Association does not manage or rent individual properties' and 'All rentals & property sales within Venture Out are independently owned and managed. Owners who rent or sell do so directly, on-line, and through agents or realtors.' Its on-site realtor Bluescape Vacation Rentals (bluescapevacations.com/florida-keys-vacation-rentals/rv-lots) lists each owner's RV lot as a separate vacation-rental property (45 lots, 16 of them marked Long Term). Its terms say 'All reservations are subject to final approval from the local Rental Manager', and they also require a signed rental agreement and a copy of the guest's driver's license. Other owners' lots sell on VRBO (one with a 5-night minimum) and through Waterfront Keys Realty by inquiry. Under AWH's owner-lot rule (2026-10-30), nights sold only by owners or their agents, with no normal campground booking site, are a skip.
name: Venture Out Resort
flags: Owner-lot condo: Venture Out at Cudjoe Cay, Inc. has 659 units (1/659 cost shares in its Declaration, cited in a 2010 Florida PSC filing), a mix of RV lots and mobile homes. Bluescape's realtor site lists about 29 RV lots for short stays (45 RV lots, 16 marked 'Long Term') beside about 100 homes. That is about 4% of the units, so the park would also fail the 1-in-10 test if the Bluescape lots were counted as the rental program.

If AWH counts Bluescape (it calls itself the 'Official On-Site Real Estate Sales and Rental Management Company of Venture Out') as a rental manager: its pages do take dates and payment, but every booking is 'subject to final approval from the local Rental Manager', with a signed rental agreement and a copy of the guest's driver's license. Venture Out adds a $125 registration/check-in fee on arrival, a $150-250 refundable deposit is due at booking, and card payments carry a 4% fee. The renter must be 25+ and must own the RV. Bluescape quotes 'from $100-$150 per night' per lot. I could not get a dated quote from its engine.
Quality is not the issue: Google 4.3/803, and Bluescape's lot reviews are 5-star (2023-2024).
